checks.finding: K1 — all 685 POSEIDON spectra are wavelength-constant; the cross-generator axis has no signal
checks.question: Does each stored spectrum vary across wavelength bins, and does that variation exceed the noise?
checks.criterion: zero bit-constant rows AND median feature/sigma > 1 AND median std_bins/|mean_bins| > 1e-4

checks.finding: K2 — every cross-generator model is worse than a constant predictor; no table reports a baseline
checks.question: For each reported mRMSE, what is the trivial-baseline mRMSE on the same rows, and is the skill positive?
checks.criterion: skill = 1 - reported/(train-mean baseline) > 0 for every number presented as a model result

checks.finding: K3 — the ExoBiome-vs-SOTA comparison mixes two input conventions; the ranking reverses when they are equalised
checks.question: What is each model's mRMSE with and without eval-time N(0,sigma) injection, on the same split?
checks.criterion: sign(ExoBiome - baseline) is invariant to the input convention

checks.finding: K4 — reported metrics use quantum_scale=1.0 (never validated); selection ran at 0.5
checks.question: Which quantum_scale reproduces holdout_metrics.json / validation_metrics.json, and what is the gate-off value?
checks.criterion: some swept scale reproduces a published number AND it equals the selection-time scale from history.csv

checks.finding: K5 / K3 — the flagship checkpoint comes from an 8/30-epoch aborted run; the baseline stopped at 79/300 on a different metric
checks.question: Did each reported run converge, on the metric it is compared on, selected on the full split?
checks.criterion: terminated by its own rule AND reported metric plateaued AND selection metric == reported metric AND full-split selection

checks.finding: K6 — 24 of 69,434 'quantum branch' parameters are quantum; the branch is a second classical head
checks.question: What fraction of the quantum pathway is quantum, and is the on/off ablation parameter-matched?
checks.criterion: quantum branch adds <1% extra classical parameters over the classical-only model

checks.finding: K7 — 'the model learned to silence the quantum branch' is unsupported: the gate is zero-initialised and was still growing
checks.question: Is gate~=0.046 a converged equilibrium or an artifact of zero-init plus a truncated schedule?
checks.criterion: gate is converged (run terminated by its own rule) AND per-gas gates agree in sign

checks.finding: K8 — the reported 0.30 dex beats the reference nested-sampling retrieval ~3.8x; the metric measures simulator inversion, not retrieval
checks.question: How does the model's RMSE compare with the reference Bayesian posterior on the same planets?
checks.criterion: model mRMSE >= reference-run mRMSE, both on the same 663 planets that carry a reference retrieval

checks.finding: W14 / K3 — the stored ADC spectra carry high-frequency scatter well below the quoted sigma
checks.question: Is the bin-to-bin scatter of instrument_spectrum consistent with a realization of N(0, instrument_noise)?
checks.criterion: R statistic distribution centred at >= 1 (consistent with noise present at full sigma)

checks.finding: P1 / P2 / U4 — taurex_fmpe holdout == validation; noquant copies val->holdout; testdata == holdout; no in-domain TauREx test split
checks.question: Does any package report as 'holdout' rows that were used for early stopping or model selection?
checks.criterion: validation and holdout selectors differ AND row overlap is zero in every package

checks.finding: P3 — the quantum-vs-noquant comparison is unmatched on ~10 axes, including two different losses under one name
checks.question: Which configuration fields differ between two runs presented as an ablation pair?
checks.criterion: differences confined to the declared factor under study

checks.finding: P7 / P4 — all 'significance' is row bootstrap on one checkpoint; no seed variance, no multiplicity control
checks.question: Is the resampling unit the right one for the claim, and can the set sizes resolve the claimed effects?
checks.criterion: effect claims backed by >=5 seeds (derived from repo files) and larger than the across-seed spread

checks.finding: P6 / U8 — several headline numbers have no backing artifact; the verification doc and plan-of-record are not in git
checks.question: Can each published number be re-derived from a committed artifact?
checks.criterion: every result number is recomputable from committed predictions, and its document is tracked

checks.finding: U6 — flagship CLI entrypoints and the Garnet port import a non-existent module; the evidence script loads a missing checkpoint
checks.question: Do all documented entrypoints, tests and analysis scripts resolve their imports and file paths?
checks.criterion: all referenced modules resolve and all hard-coded artifact paths exist

checks.finding: K9 — the model predicts 5 of its benchmark's 7 parameters; T is leaked by aux on ADC and wholly absent on cross-generator
checks.question: What does omitting temperature and planet radius from the target vector cost, per dataset?
checks.criterion: model predicts the full benchmark parameter vector, or omitted params are both weakly coupled and input-determined

checks.finding: U2 / U3 / K9(d) — 5 of 8 crossgen aux features are constants; temperature_k varies 500-1800 K and is read by nobody
checks.question: Which model inputs carry no information, and which informative label columns are never read?
checks.criterion: no zero-variance input dims, no scalar-broadcast channel, no unread varying label column

checks.finding: K10 — scored on the metrics the challenge actually used, a point estimate is at or near the worst attainable value
checks.question: What do ExoBiome and the NSF baseline score on the ADC2022/ADC2023 distributional metrics?
checks.criterion: point model has positive KS skill against the PRIOR arm (beats a model that ignores the spectrum)

checks.finding: K2 (extension) — how much of the reported skill survives when the spectrum is removed
checks.question: Constant vs aux-only vs spectrum-only vs both: where does the skill come from?
checks.criterion: upper end of the CI on the aux-only skill share < 20 % of the aux+spectrum skill, on every dataset, and every dataset has a positive aux+spectrum skill to divide

checks.finding: K1 — root-cause diagnosis for the wavelength-constant POSEIDON spectra
checks.question: Which API misuse makes POSEIDON return spectra with no wavelength dependence?
checks.criterion: the repo's exact call reproduces a spectrum with the same relative variation as tau (~1e-2)

checks.finding: A0.2 — row-by-row fidelity of the reconstructed ExoBiome input pipeline (underpins K3, K4, K9)
checks.question: Do the reconstruction's predictions match the artifact's saved predictions row by row, not just on average?
checks.criterion: max |diff| per row per gas < 1e-4 vs mac_holdout_predictions.csv at quantum_scale=1.0

checks.finding: K1(b) — the team's own ridge smoke baseline ran, shipped in the bundle, and records no skill on POSEIDON
checks.question: Do the two smoke artefacts agree per gas, what skill is behind them, and how wide are the predictions?
checks.criterion: the finding is REFUTED (PASS) if an artefact is missing, or the CSV does not reproduce the JSON within 1e-9, or the two skills share a sign, or any file outside the bundle / audit/ / docs/ reads the artefacts by path; it STANDS (FAIL) otherwise
